asset_label: exterior wall or appurtenance of a building greater than six stories (facade panel, masonry, window frame, parapet, balcony, sealant joint) in a drone, phone or close-up photo
source_note: 1 RCNY 103-04 (NYC Facade Inspection and Safety Program, Local Law 11), https://www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/rules/1_RCNY_103-04.pdf, fetched 2026-09-25. Definitions in the Safe, SWARMP and Unsafe rows are quoted from section (a) of the rule. The rule also says: "The use of drones, high resolution photography, non-destructive testing, or other similar methods does not eliminate the requirements for close-up inspections." This grade is a pre-classification for the Qualified Exterior Wall Inspector (QEWI), never a filing. The unified mapping (Safe S0, SWARMP S2, Unsafe S3) is the team's own [team-proposed, validate].

rows.criterion: "A condition of a building wall, any appurtenances thereto or any part thereof not requiring repair or maintenance to sustain the structural integrity of the exterior of the building and that will not become unsafe during the next five years." Only when the photo shows the element surface clearly; otherwise U.

"A condition of a building wall, any appurtenances thereto or any part thereof that is safe at the time of inspection, but requires repairs or maintenance during the next five years, but not less than one year, in order to prevent its deterioration into an unsafe condition during that five-year period."

"A condition of a building wall, any appurtenances thereto, or any part thereof that is hazardous to persons or property and requires repair within one (1) year of completion of critical examinations. In addition, any condition that was reported as SWARMP in a previous report and that is not corrected at the time of the current inspection must be reported as an unsafe condition."
Photo cannot show the element surface (distance, blur, glare, occlusion) or the condition needs a close-up or probe: grade U with not_measurable, never Safe. Project rule: U is never S0.
rows.source: project rule (U is never S0); close-up requirement quoted from 1 RCNY 103-04 https://www.nyc.gov/assets/buildings/rules/1_RCNY_103-04.pdf

unified_note: Unsafe with material loose, displaced or detached above a public right-of-way maps to S4 (escalate) [team-proposed, validate]. The rule requires the QEWI to notify DOB and the owner immediately on discovery of an Unsafe condition.
examples: Distress named in report item C of the rule: cracking, bulging, water entry, and lintel or shelf-angle movement.
measurement_note: Crack width only through cascade.measure with a scale (GSD or a two-point reference), reported as width +/- uncertainty. Photos for the report must be at least 800 x 600 px (FISP_MIN_PHOTO_PX, 1 RCNY 103-04).

flags.not_measurable: set when the photo cannot show the surface or a needed dimension has no scale
